display_name: Awareness E13: The AI assistant (defend only)
description: An awareness episode of about 8 minutes for all staff, on the defending side only. Handle a supplier email, a voicemail and a video call at Brightwell Foods, a fictional company, beside its approved assistant: some are real and some were built to look right. Each answer is explained, and checking another way when you're unsure is always fine and never marked down.
